intent.proves: The percentage of active master products in scope with an image asset or a product image field meets the selected profile assertion; documents and videos are not images.
intent.scope: Active master products of the default language in scope; image assets are file details with extension jpg, jpeg, png, gif, webp, avif or svg.

bindings.reason: Requires complete joins and raw/fallback semantics parity before this binding may execute.

bindings.query: SELECT ISNULL(100 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomProducts p WHERE p.ProductLanguageId = N'{lang}' AND p.ProductActive = 1 AND ISNULL(p.ProductVariantId, N'') = N''{inScope} AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomDetails d WHERE d.DetailProductId = p.ProductId AND d.DetailType = 0 AND (LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.jpg' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.jpeg' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.png' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.gif' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.webp' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.avif' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.svg')) OR ISNULL(p.ProductImageSmall, N'') + ISNULL(p.ProductImageMedium, N'') + ISNULL(p.ProductImageLarge, N'') <> N'')) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomProducts p WHERE p.ProductLanguageId = N'{lang}' AND p.ProductActive = 1 AND ISNULL(p.ProductVariantId, N'') = N''{inScope}), 0), 0)
